about: The definition of the thought line (docs/design/transcript/spec.md, 'The thought line (engine)'). `lines`: the reasoning so far and the line to show (null: nothing yet); a case with `chunks` appends them in order and gives the line after each. `streams`: chunks with the ms they arrive at and the `thought` the delta carries (null: none, the line doesn't change), then the `shown` list the completed reasoning item carries, offsets in UTF-16 code units into `final` (or into everything streamed). The engine's tests (crates/frog-engine/src/thought_tests.rs) run every case; the apps load it to check they show `thought` verbatim. Every case is synthetic.
